jobs.title: Backend Developer dotNet AWS
jobs.description:
**Backend Developer dotNet and AWS**
------------------------------------

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

**Your role:**

We are looking for an experienced **Backend Developer with AWS** experience who enjoys taking ownership and driving work from idea to production. You are comfortable working in a complex environment, eager to understand the business and domain, and motivated by improving both the product and the way we work.

In this role you will play a key role in:

* Developing and modernizing backend services using **C# and .NET 10**
* Designing scalable, cloud-native solutions on **AWS**
* Building applications using **Entity Framework** and relational databases
* Contributing to **CI/CD pipelines** , deployment processes and engineering best practices
* Collaborating with business stakeholders, developers and architects in an international environment
* Taking ownership of solutions from requirements through implementation, deployment and support

**Your profile:**

* Strong hands-on experience with **C# and .NET**
* Experience with **Entity Framework** and relational databases
* Solid AWS knowledge and experience with cloud-based architectures
* Experience with **GitLab** , CI/CD practices and modern software delivery processes
* Good understanding of SOLID principles, clean code and Agile/Kanban ways of working
* Ability to independently drive development activities from requirements to production support
  

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with **Docker** and containerized applications
* Experience with **AWS CDK** , cloud-native development and cloud migration initiatives
* Experience owning and maintaining **CI/CD pipelines**
* Experience with **PostgreSQL**
* Experience modernizing legacy applications and architectures
* Experience with **WPF (.NET Framework 4.8)** and **CoreWCF/service-oriented architectures**
  

**What you will love about working here**

**Impact & Ownership:** Work on a strategically important platform used across multiple brands and countries within the TRATON Group, with the opportunity to influence technical direction and modernization initiatives.

**Modernization Journey:** Be part of the transformation from legacy technologies toward modern .NET, AWS, cloud-native architectures, and scalable integrations.

**Learning & Growth:** Expand your expertise across backend development, cloud technologies, architecture, integrations, and business-critical product configuration systems.

**Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing:** Join a team that values collaboration, technical excellence, domain knowledge, and continuous improvement.

**International Environment:** Work closely with stakeholders, architects, and developers from different countries and business areas in a truly international setup.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

**Make it real** . | www.capgemini.com

jobs.description:
### **General Information**

**Locations**: Bucharest, Romania

Role ID

216290

Worker Type

Temporary Employee

Studio/Department

EA Studios - SPORTS

Work Model

Hybrid

### **Description & Requirements**

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games. After nearly 30 years of creating genre-defining, interactive football experiences with the world's biggest football entertainment platform, EA SPORTS FC, we are soon beginning an exciting new era. EA SPORTS FC will become the future of football from EA SPORTS – as we strive to take global football experiences to new heights, on behalf of football fans everywhere.

  

With more opportunity than ever to innovate and create new, authentic experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and immersion to a global community of fans, we invite you to join us and pioneer the future of football with EA SPORTS!

  

**The Role**

EA Sports FC Ultimate Teams C++ Engineers work on the Client side of the FC Ultimate Team game mode, using C++ technology.

  

As part of the EA Sports FC Ultimate Team you will work on the features that build the most played game mode of the FC game, using the existing architecture or by bringing improvements to the UI Framework and Frostbite add-ons that we are using to build the features. EA Sports FC Ultimate team is an exclusive Online game mode so you will be working side-by-side with the Server team members, to be able to implement features like stadium customization, season objectives, FUT club or transfer market.

  

**What you will do as a EA Sports FC Ultimate Team Engineer:**

  

* Design and implement features for EA Sports FC Ultimate team game mode, but also other game modes within the product
  
* Design, maintain, implement, test and debug code, pipelines and other Ultimate Team related sub-components and packages.
  
* Work with Server Engineers, Production and Interface Designers to gather requirements and write technical design specifications
  
* You will report to one of the EA Sports FC ultimate team's managers and work with your peers to develop FC Ultimate team features
  

**We're looking for:**

  

* Object-oriented programming experience of OO design principles, 4+ years experience in C++ software development
  
* Experience in UI technologies (Qt, Unity or Unreal UI frameworks or web front-end development) is very nice to have
  
* Familiarity with ActionScript and scripting languages (Python, Lua), C# and SQL is nice to have
  
* Demonstrates curiosity and openness toward new technologies, proactively upskilling and applying new knowledge to improve individual and team outcomes
  
* Ability to work with existing and unfamiliar code, Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve complex issues by breaking them down into actionable steps and implementing effective, pragmatic solutions
  
* Build strong partnerships with peers and stakeholders

  
  

***About Electronic Arts***

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

  

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

  

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Type:**

Permanent

**Build a brilliant future with Hiscox**

**The role**

We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic professional who will be a key and influential member of our Hiscox London Market Engineering Team, within the Software Engineering Chapter. In this role you will be working in one of our various squads as we create new “Cloud First” solutions to add value to the business, while supporting and transforming our existing on-prem and cloud systems. We are looking for someone who is aligned with modern software engineering practices and ready to embrace the use of AI enabled development tool and adapt to the ever changing space as we enter the agentic SDLC phase to allow rapid delivery of high quality value.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Work collaboratively with your squad and stakeholders to contribute to delivering business outcomes
* Write clean, maintainable code following best practices such as SOLID principles, design patterns, unit testing, peer review, and CI/CD processes
* Ensure documentation are up to date and detailed comments added to the stories
* Support team members by learning from others and sharing knowledge as you grow in your role
* Assist in designing solutions and implementing changes based on requirements
* Collaborate with engineers across teams to learn about and contribute to our architecture
* Ensure your work follows security and engineering standards with support from the team
* Be open to learning and adopting new ways of working, including AI-assisted development tools and ever changing space as we enter agentic SDLC phase
* Work collaboratively with team members located in the United Kingdom, Portugal, Poland, and India to deliver value

**Skills**:

* Academic degree in a closely related field (or 3+ years employment in a Software Engineering role)
* Candidates should have a strong foundation and hands-on experience in C# and .NET, with the ability to write and maintain effective unit tests.
* Should have a solid background in SQL and be comfortable working with relational databases
* Should have knowledge on CI/CD pipelines and a good understanding of source control systems and branching strategies
* Exposure to Azure technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, and Azure API Management (APIM) would be considered an advantage
* Knowledge on Azure Service Bus would be advantageous, particularly in event-driven or messaging-based architectures.
* Familiarity with modern front-end technologies such as Blazor/Angular/React would be beneficial for building responsive and user-friendly applications.

### **Behaviours**

* Demonstrates enthusiasm for learning new technologies, tools, and ways of working, actively seeking opportunities to grow technical and professional skills.
* Takes ownership of assigned tasks and delivers work to agreed standards with appropriate support and guidance.
* Communicates clearly and respectfully with colleagues, asking thoughtful questions and sharing progress proactively.
* Collaborates effectively with teammates and contributes positively to an inclusive and supportive team environment.
* Shows curiosity about the business, customers, and products, seeking to understand how their work contributes to business outcomes.
* Follows established engineering standards, development practices, and security requirements, while building a strong foundation in software engineering principles.
* Approaches challenges with a positive mindset, demonstrating resilience and a willingness to learn from mistakes and feedback.
* Adapts to changing priorities and embraces new ways of working in a fast-paced environment.
* Seeks and acts upon feedback to continuously improve technical skills, effectiveness, and professional development.
* Demonstrates attention to detail and a commitment to producing reliable, well-tested, and maintainable solutions.
* Contributes ideas and suggestions for improving processes, team practices, and customer outcomes.
* Builds positive working relationships through professionalism, respect, empathy, and a willingness to support others.
* Takes responsibility for personal learning and development and actively participates in knowledge-sharing opportunities.
* Demonstrates a growth mindset, showing initiative and motivation to broaden technical expertise and industry knowledge.

**Diversity and flexible working at Hiscox:**

At Hiscox we care about our people. We hire the best people for the job and we’re committed to diversity and creating a truly inclusive culture, which we believe drives success.

We have also learned over the past couple of years that working life doesn’t always have to be in the office, and have adopted hybrid ways of working to encourage a healthy work life balance.

We see it as the best of both worlds: structure and sociability on one hand, and independence and flexibility on the other.

If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we’d still love to hear from you.

*Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture*

jobs.title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!
Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken
8,5 medewerkers tevredenheid

jobs.description:
Full Stack .NET Developer

(Tech stack: .NET 8, C#, Angular, MSSQL, SignalR, REST APIs, Azure Service Bus)

Our client is a specialist software company delivering tailored platforms within the media and publishing sector. They are looking to recruit a Full Stack .NET Developer / Technical Consultant to join their growing team.
This is a primarily remote role combining hands-on development with customer-facing consultancy and project coordination. You will work closely with B2B customers to understand requirements, shape technical solutions, and help drive successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and maintain applications using modern Microsoft technologies.
Build new features and functionality based on customer requirements.
Work directly with customers to gather and refine technical specifications.
Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Provide technical consultancy and coordinate delivery with the development team.
Contribute to architecture discussions and technical decision-making.

Skills & Experience:
Strong commercial experience with .NET and C#.
Solid hands-on experience with Angular.
Strong knowledge of MSSQL and advanced T-SQL.
Experience with REST APIs, SignalR, and Azure Service Bus.
Comfortable working directly with customers in a consultative environment.
Strong communication and organisational skills.

Fluent Dutch and English language skills are essential.

Location: Deventer, Overijssel, Netherlands (Primarily Remote)
Salary: €70,000 – €100,000

This is an excellent opportunity for a developer who enjoys combining technical delivery with customer interaction in a flexible, collaborative environment.
Applicants must have the right to work in the Netherlands.
